name: Talking to Boop after a failure gets a face on your side
case: The agent's turn fails and Boop turns grumpy. The person then vents that this is so frustrating, and a little later says they'll get it next time. Boop answers both with a face, never none. It takes their side at the venting (determined, grumpy or sad, never happy), and perks up at the encouragement (determined, proud, happy or excited, never grumpy or sad).
why: PERSONALITY: talked to, Boop always answers with a face, never none, and is always on the person's side (BEHAVIORS.md §3.3). Venting isn't rude to Boop, so it isn't the grumpy-at-insults case

steps.words: don't worry, we'll get it next time
